# Simple access: link address is suggested, clearer button
### Changed
- **Simple access: the address for the link is suggested.** When the frame runs from outside (a tablet at your parents'), the frame page reports the address it runs under, so the field "Address the person uses to reach the server" is already filled in. The field is now marked as an internet address, so browsers no longer put a postal address there. The "Create access" button is highlighted and is no longer overlooked.

Update: `cd ~/immich-showcase && docker compose pull && docker compose up -d`. ☕ [ko-fi.com/frameside](https://ko-fi.com/frameside)
